t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When selecting a gnome to gather the mushrooms, the key is to alternate between the red and yellow basket but sticking with each colour until it yields 1 or 0. Selecting the red, pink, purple or brown gnome will get you the red basket. Whereas selecting the yellow, orange, blue or green gnome will get you the yellow basket.

vb_textbox.text: I found that the selection of baskets in the end was completely random. I tried to follow a pattern at the beginning based off guidance from previous participants then switched to making random decisions and noticed no real meaningful change in the number of mushrooms I yielded.
